-- name: Ulkar_Jollkarek
-- Generated by scripts/quests/velious-armor.mjs; edit the manifest/compiler, not this file.
-- P99: https://wiki.project1999.com/Wizard_Kael_Armor_Quests (sha256 9e792c129ff2d1644841a6ab152aca57b5d1eb55e1ca5bf4fd49589427295524)
-- Dialogue source: server/internal/quest/upstream/projecteq/kael/Ulkar_Jollkarek.pl (sha256 6b3462af2e2f5aae9b3038657ae52665aec0bc373f31c09b32ffa0bc8ff2066a)
-- No class/level hand-in gate. Quest faction prerequisites are intentionally bypassed.
-- Recipe quantities/rewards are P99-reviewed; reward magnitudes and limitations are documented in docs/velious-armor-quests.md.
local item_lib = require("items")

function event_say(e)
  if e.message:findi("hail") then
    e.self:Say("Greetings to you. I seek one that calls himself a wizard. What do you call yourself, manling?")
  end
  if e.message:findi("i am a wizard") then
    e.self:Say("Excellent. Are you sure enough of your skills to undertake my tasks? If not, get out of my sight, weakling!")
  end
  if e.message:findi("undertake your tasks") then
    e.self:Say("I thought so. One should never back down from a challenge. Once you have completed them I will have a cap, a robe, sleeves, wristbands, gloves, leggings and boots to reward you with.")
  end
  if e.message:findi("cap") then
    e.self:Say("For you to receive my gift, I shall require an ancient silk turban and three crushed flame opals.")
  end
  if e.message:findi("robe") then
    e.self:Say("This exquisite robe shall be yours in exchange for an ancient silk robe and three pristine emeralds.")
  end
  if e.message:findi("sleeves") then
    e.self:Say("For these durable sleeves, you must fetch me a pair of ancient silk sleeves and three flawed topazes.")
  end
  if e.message:findi("wristband") then
    e.self:Say("The crafting of this wristband requires that you bring me an ancient silk wristband and three crushed onyx sapphire pieces.")
  end
  if e.message:findi("gloves") then
    e.self:Say("For this fine pair of gloves you must seek out and return to me a pair of ancient silk gloves and a crushed topaz.")
  end
  if e.message:findi("leggings") then
    e.self:Say("This pair of leggings will yours provided you supply me with a pair of ancient silk pantaloons as well as three nephrites.")
  end
  if e.message:findi("boots") then
    e.self:Say("These supple boots shall be yours upon receipt of a pair of ancient silk boots and three crushed jaundice gems.")
  end
end

function event_trade(e)
  if item_lib.check_turn_in(e.trade, { item1 = 24926, item2 = 25837, item3 = 25837, item4 = 25837 }) then -- Circlet of the Invoker
    e.self:Say("You have done well.")
    e.other:SummonItem(25405)
    e.other:AddEXP(150000)
    e.other:Faction(429, 20, 0)
    e.other:Faction(448, 20, 0)
    e.other:Faction(419, 20, 0)
    e.other:Faction(430, -20, 0)
  elseif item_lib.check_turn_in(e.trade, { item1 = 24921, item2 = 25807, item3 = 25807, item4 = 25807 }) then -- Robe of the Invoker
    e.self:Say("You have done well.")
    e.other:SummonItem(25406)
    e.other:AddEXP(150000)
    e.other:Faction(429, 20, 0)
    e.other:Faction(448, 20, 0)
    e.other:Faction(419, 20, 0)
    e.other:Faction(430, -20, 0)
  elseif item_lib.check_turn_in(e.trade, { item1 = 24923, item2 = 25818, item3 = 25818, item4 = 25818 }) then -- Sleeves of the Invoker
    e.self:Say("You have done well.")
    e.other:SummonItem(25407)
    e.other:AddEXP(150000)
    e.other:Faction(429, 20, 0)
    e.other:Faction(448, 20, 0)
    e.other:Faction(419, 20, 0)
    e.other:Faction(430, -20, 0)
  elseif item_lib.check_turn_in(e.trade, { item1 = 24925, item2 = 25841, item3 = 25841, item4 = 25841 }) then -- Bangle of the Invoker
    e.self:Say("You have done well.")
    e.other:SummonItem(25408)
    e.other:AddEXP(150000)
    e.other:Faction(429, 20, 0)
    e.other:Faction(448, 20, 0)
    e.other:Faction(419, 20, 0)
    e.other:Faction(430, -20, 0)
  elseif item_lib.check_turn_in(e.trade, { item1 = 24927, item2 = 25832, item3 = 25832, item4 = 25832 }) then -- Gloves of the Invoker
    e.self:Say("You have done well.")
    e.other:SummonItem(25409)
    e.other:AddEXP(150000)
    e.other:Faction(429, 20, 0)
    e.other:Faction(448, 20, 0)
    e.other:Faction(419, 20, 0)
    e.other:Faction(430, -20, 0)
  elseif item_lib.check_turn_in(e.trade, { item1 = 24922, item2 = 25816, item3 = 25816, item4 = 25816 }) then -- Pants of the Invoker
    e.self:Say("You have done well.")
    e.other:SummonItem(25410)
    e.other:AddEXP(150000)
    e.other:Faction(429, 20, 0)
    e.other:Faction(448, 20, 0)
    e.other:Faction(419, 20, 0)
    e.other:Faction(430, -20, 0)
  elseif item_lib.check_turn_in(e.trade, { item1 = 24924, item2 = 25829, item3 = 25829, item4 = 25829 }) then -- Boots of the Invoker
    e.self:Say("You have done well.")
    e.other:SummonItem(25411)
    e.other:AddEXP(150000)
    e.other:Faction(429, 20, 0)
    e.other:Faction(448, 20, 0)
    e.other:Faction(419, 20, 0)
    e.other:Faction(430, -20, 0)
  end
  -- Return every unconsumed item and coin, including on successful offers.
  item_lib.return_items(e.self, e.other, e.trade)
end
